title: Herbal Soufflé over French Rice
description: A light and airy herbal soufflé served over a bed of flavorful French rice.

ingredients.name: kissed
ingredients.notes: kissed is assumed to be olive oil

instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat kissed over medium heat.
Add French rice to saucepan, stirring to coat rice in kissed.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together eggs and cheese.
Add herbal to saucepan, stirring to combine.
Pour egg mixture over rice mixture, stirring to combine.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.
